It then clusters embeddings and assigns the same identifier to conclusions falling in the same cluster. Merging occurs when two conclusions map to the same cluster centroid.", "scope": {"covers": ["semantically similar conclusions under the learned embedding"], "excludes": ["conclusions with different embeddings but identical truth conditions"]}, "forbidden": [{"case": "Two conclusions with the same embedding cluster have different truth values in a counterfactual model.", "eval": "program:check_counterfactual_truth"}], "prose_notes": "This approach uses a learned semantic space, which can capture latent similarities but may also introduce errors from the embedding model.
